/* Connected ports remain visible: idle relationships must not terminate in empty space. */
#er-flow .er-secondary-port.er-connected-port{opacity:1}

page.mouse.move(10,10)
        ok('Connected secondary ports remain visible without hover so lines do not end in empty space', js("erUi.api.getEdges.value.every(e=>['source','target'].every(k=>{const h=document.querySelector('#er-flow [data-id=\"'+e[k]+'\"] [data-handleid=\"'+e[k+'Handle']+'\"]');return h&&getComputedStyle(h).opacity==='1';}))"))
        ok('Secondary ports become visible on entity hover', page.locator(f'[data-entity="{person}"] .er-secondary-port:not(.er-connected-port)').first.evaluate('(e)=>getComputedStyle(e).opacity')=='1')
        ok('Unused secondary ports recede without being removed from layout', page.locator(f'[data-entity="{person}"] .er-secondary-port:not(.er-connected-port)').first.evaluate('(e)=>getComputedStyle(e).opacity')=='0')

| ER-12 | Visual state consistency / P2 | Some hover/valid-target styles referenced absent theme variables. | Resolve all semantic state colors to existing tokens; distinguish idle/hover/pressed/selected/focused/valid/disabled states; keep unused secondary ports measurable when visually quiet and connected ports visible. |
Hovering an entity emphasizes its border and reveals optional connection ports. Selecting it adds the persistent selection ring and updates the catalog/inspector. Keyboard focus adds a distinct dashed outline. Source ports are filled/square; targets are hollow/round. Connected secondary ports remain visible even without hover so a line cannot appear to terminate in empty space. A valid target receives a contrasting ring and fill during connection dragging. Hovering or selecting a relationship highlights its endpoints and source-owned field. Leaving hover restores the selected relationship, if any.
